about: PS2_ASHLEY (lane ps2cast 2026-10-14, default off; render only): Ashley (pl11, cSubAshley, pSUB id 3) on her PS2 model. ps2_ashley.py conversion: 141-joint GC skeleton kept for the full source proof, 68 draw slots, PS2 cloth weights moved onto the GC cloth links the source solver already moves (no second solver, no RNG). Seven sections in cSubAshley::modelSet order: body 4/5, head 7/0xB, hair 6/8, extra 9/5, extra 0xA/5, right hand 0xC/5, left hand 0xF/5 (ashley11); ashley11-h1 / -h3: the setHand(1) / setHand(3) hand pairs (the chunks they share are stored once). Room package r113 (lane ps2cast 2026-10-15, offline): Ashley follows Leon here in chapter 2.
